responsibility: Implements gimple_ranger, GCC’s primary GIMPLE/SSA value-range query engine. It answers ranges for expressions, statements, block entries/exits, and CFG edges by combining direct statement folding, cached global and per-block ranges, outgoing-edge constraints, inferred side-effect ranges, and GORI-based recomputation; it also provides the enable_ranger/disable_ranger function hooks and the assume_query helper that back-solves assumptions from a function’s return value.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the gimple-range interface: it contains the executable logic of gimple_ranger and assume_query, including range computation on statements/edges/blocks and the enable_ranger/disable_ranger function bodies, whereas gcc/gimple-range.h only declares those APIs and aggregates the related range-engine headers.
